structured_output.what_is_happening: Stockdrip is a pump.fun bonding-curve coin, about 40 minutes old. It pumped to an all-time high near a $46k market cap (ath_price 4.61e-5 in GMGN data), then crashed. At the trigger, price was down 50-68% in the last 5 minutes, and the latest DexScreener read shows about $11.8k market cap, -57% over 5 minutes, +215% over 1 hour. The coin is tied to a real product site, stockdrip.fun. The site pitches a tool for launching pump.fun coins whose creator fees buy a basket of up to five tokenized stocks (NVDAx, AAPLx, SPYx and others) and pay them to holders every 5 minutes. The story fits real, recent pump.fun news: on 2026-09-09 pump.fun added tokenized-stock trading pairs and holder rewards. The creator has already closed their position (creator_close, 0% held), and GMGN flags a community takeover.

narrative.description: A tokenized-stock 'dividend drip' meme/utility coin. It rides pump.fun's September 2026 launch of tokenized-stock pairs and holder-reward coins.
narrative.why_spreading: The pump.fun tokenized-stock and holder-reward news is current (announced Sept 9, 2026), and stockdrip.fun is a working product pitch. I found no organic X, Reddit or news discussion of this specific token. The early volume looks mostly like trenches and bundle flow, not an audience that found the product on its own.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its DexScreener and GMGN profile links stockdrip.fun and @Stockdripfun, and its description matches the site. That makes it the likely platform/flagship coin. The website itself does not show a contract address.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There is one same-name copy (29b2vJoh...pump), created about 4 minutes later, with about $3.4k market cap and negligible volume.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 163 of 253 traders as bundler wallets and 231 as fresh wallets. The creator has exited and a community takeover is flagged. Nobody has paid for DexScreener boosts or ads. Buyer/seller counts are high (965 unique buyers in 1h), but many are likely bots and bundles. I found no organic posts on X, Reddit or in news. The dev's X account has launched 3 tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is inaccessible (403), and search engines index it poorly. The product team could still be promoting through channels I can't see.

structural_risks: Price is already down about 75% from ATH, with a sharp dump in the last 5 minutes
The dev has sold out (creator_close); a community takeover means no active dev support
On the bonding curve at about $12k market cap, sellers can push it toward curve floor levels; a -50% stop is near about $6k
Top-10 holders own about 17.6%, which is moderate and spread out, but bundles may be split across wallets

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is real and timely, and the site suggests an actual builder. At a tiny $12k cap, just a few SOL of buying doubles it, and it has already printed $46k once. If the team or KOLs push the product on X, or the drip feature visibly starts paying holders, a second leg back to $25k+ is very plausible. Activity is very high (about 500 transactions per 5 minutes), so attention clearly hasn't vanished.

source_coverage.notes: News covers pump.fun's tokenized-stock pairs but not this token. A contract-address search found nothing. The X profile fetch returned 403. Reddit blocked the fetch, and web search found no Reddit or Telegram mentions.

structured_output.thesis: A good, timely product narrative on a coin that has already done its first pump (to about $46k) and is now dumping hard. The dev is out and bundlers dominate. A second leg is possible, but the more likely path is a continued bleed to curve-floor levels.
